Vegetarian’s Delight!
Feb 2020 • Couples
We were looking for a good vegetarian place to eat on our night in Ho Chi Minh when we discovered the Sen Vegan House in the heart of the city.
I can not recommend this place enough. Whether you are vegan/ vegetarian or not - the food here was incredible. If we had not been so full, we would have ordered more! The spring rolls were a particular favourite. So fresh!
The service was ok. Not bad but not super great but the food was worth every moment. 
Highly recommend! We will definitely visit them again.

Absolutely perfect!
Aug 2019 • Couples
Completely by good fortune we had booked a hotel only 3 minutes away from Sen. On our first evening after travel we were quite tired so we decided to stay local which is when we found Sen.

The menu is broad and imaginative and the food top class. Many people still believe that vegan means boiled carrots and potatoes but a visit to Sen will prove that vegan can easily be the tastiest food around!

We were in Saigon for 6 nights and for 4 of those nights we made a point of getting back to our hotel area purposely so that we could go to Sen it was that good.

The staff are very friendly and both service and price were great. Feeling hungry in Saigon then you should drop by here, you will be glad you did!
